audience: Warp is for people who want a terminal and an agent CLI, and who want the included agent usage written in dollars. The verdict says Build is $20 a month and includes $20 of agent usage at API rates, so extra use is pay-as-you-go. The free plan still includes the terminal and the agent CLI.

It is a poor fit if you wanted a big team on one bill. Business stops at 25 seats. It is also a poor fit if you expected the free plan's add-ons to cost the same as paid. They do not. Free add-on prices are 20% higher than paid-plan prices.
features: Free is $0 a month and includes the terminal and the Warp Agent CLI. You can use your own API keys or a custom endpoint on the free plan. That is a real free product, not a disabled shell.

Build is $20 a month, or $18 a month on the annual plan, and includes $20 of agent usage each month. Max is $200 a month, or $180 on the annual plan, and includes $200 of usage. Business is $50 per user a month, or $45 on the annual plan, up to 25 seats, with $20 of usage per seat. Enterprise is custom.

The included usage is stated at API rates. Build's included usage equals the $20 price. You are prepaying a usage pool that matches the seat, and anything past it is pay-as-you-go. That is easy to understand and easy to outgrow.
limitations: A $20 seat that includes $20 of usage is not a discount. It is a prepaid pool. The cons say extra use is pay-as-you-go. If your agent month is larger than $20 of API rates, Build is a down payment.

Warp Factories are billed separately. Pay as you go is $0 a month with usage at 20% above API rates. Factories Build is $20 a month with usage at API rates. Factories Business is $50 per user a month. Enterprise is custom. The page says factory usage is billed separately. Do not assume the terminal plan covers it.

The page does not state a yearly dollar total, so none is shown. The annual figures we print are the monthly equivalents already on the card: $18, $180, and $45. The rating is Depends because the pool equals the price.

faqs.q: Does Build include more usage than it costs?
faqs.a: No. Build is $20 a month and includes $20 of agent usage at API rates. Extra use is pay-as-you-go. The annual Build price is $18 a month, and the included usage in the FAQ is still $20.

faqs.q: Is the free plan a demo terminal?
faqs.a: No. Free is $0 and includes the terminal and the Warp Agent CLI, plus your own API keys or a custom endpoint. Add-on prices on Free are 20% higher than on paid plans.
No. Factory usage is billed separately. Pay as you go is 20% above API rates. Factories Build is $20 a month at API rates. Factories Business is $50 per user a month.

faqs.q: How many seats can Business have?
faqs.a: Up to 25. Past that, the table says Enterprise and custom. Business is $50 per user a month, or $45 on the annual plan, with $20 of usage per seat.
